nyala: [單復同]n.[動]林羚(一種南非羚羊)

n city in Sudan
n spiral-horned South African antelope with a fringe of white hairs along back and neck
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">源自聰加語與文達語</dd></dl>
nyctalopia:
n. 夜盲症
[醫] 夜盲[症](晝視)
n. inability to see clearly in dim light; due to a deficiency of vitamin A or to a retinal disorder
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">新拉丁語，源自中世紀拉丁語，源自拉丁語 nyctalops（黃昏時看不見）（源自希臘語 nyktalōp-、nyktalōps，由 nykt-（nyct-）＋ alaos（盲）＋ -ōp-、ōps（眼）構成）＋ -ia（-y）——另見 eye</dd></dl>
nylon:
n. 尼龍
[化] 尼龍; 聚醯胺纖維

n. a thermoplastic polyamide; a family of strong resilient synthetic fibers
n. a synthetic fabric

<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>整體中性；「尼龍長襪」義帶 old-fashioned 標籤</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>1900 年代的人造字，沒有詞根可拆</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>a nylon rope；a nylon tent；made of nylon</dd><dt class="w">注意事項</dt><dd class="w">複數 nylons 指尼龍長襪，字典標為過時用法</dd></dl>
nymph:
n. 居於山林水澤的仙女, 蛹, 美麗的少女
[醫] 稚蟲, 若蟲, 蝻

n. (classical mythology) a minor nature goddess usually depicted as a beautiful maiden
n. a larva of an insect with incomplete metamorphosis (as the dragonfly or mayfly)

<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>整體中性；「若蟲」義屬專業用語（字典標 technical）</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>古法語 nimphe ← 拉丁 ← 希臘 nymphe「新娘、仙女」</dd><dt>字族</dt><dd>nymphet (名詞)</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>a dragonfly nymph</dd><dt class="w">注意事項</dt><dd class="w">有兩個不同領域的意思：神話中的仙女，以及昆蟲學的「若蟲」（形態與成蟲相近的幼體）</dd></dl>
nymphaea: n. the type genus of the family Nymphaeaceae; any of a variety of water lilies
nymphalid: n medium to large butterflies found worldwide typically having brightly colored wings and much-reduced nonfunctional forelegs carried folded on the breast
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">新拉丁語 Nymphalidae</dd></dl>
nymphet: n. 早熟的少女；放蕩的少婦；仙女般的少女
n. a sexually attractive young woman
nympho: n a woman with abnormal sexual desires
nympholepsy:
n. 狂亂, 著迷, 狂熱
[醫] 性慾增盛
n. a frenzy of emotion; as for something unattainable
nymphomaniac: n. a woman with abnormal sexual desires

語感
貶義且冒犯，現代多避免使用
詞根詞綴
現代拉丁 nymphae（指女性外陰部位）＋晚期拉丁 mania「瘋狂」。同源字：maniac
字族
nymphomania (noun)
nystagmus:
n. 眼球震顫
[醫] 眼球震顫
n. involuntary movements of the eyeballs; its presence or absence is used to diagnose a variety of neurological and visual disorders
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">新拉丁語，源自希臘語 nystagmos（睏倦）；同源於希臘語 nystazein（打瞌睡、睡覺）、立陶宛語 snusti（打瞌睡），或許還同源於希臘語 nythos（黑暗）——另見 nuance</dd></dl>
nystatin: n. [微]制黴菌素,制真菌素(一種抗黴菌藥)
n an antifungal and antibiotic (trade names Mycostatin and Nystan) discovered in New York State; derived from soil fungi actinomycetes
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">紐約州（該藥在此研製）＋英語 -in</dd></dl>
